<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title". -->

## Motivation

Strix Halo/gfx1151 uses different wave-size and kernel assumptions from AMD CDNA GPUs. Qwen3.5 AWQ MoE can run through ROCm Triton, but previously used the heuristic MoE config because no Radeon 8060S profile was available.

This follows the community Strix Halo recipe in [`docs/RUNNING_AWQ_MOE.md`](https://github.com/JeremiahM37/strix-halo-sglang/blob/main/docs/RUNNING_AWQ_MOE.md) and upstreams the reproducible config/tuning pieces into SGLang.

## Modifications

- Fix packed W4A16 `N` config filename generation.
- Add Radeon 8060S/gfx1151 up/down Triton MoE configs.
- Add sequential single-GPU tuning with `--no-ray`.
- Fix the W4A16 `BLOCK_SIZE_K` compatibility filter.
- Document the Strix Halo tuning recipe.

## Accuracy Tests

The Qwen3.5 AWQ checkpoint loaded successfully on Radeon 8060S/gfx1151, both tuned configs were selected, `/health` returned HTTP 200, and a minimal chat request returned `TUNED_OK`. No model weights or forward math were changed; a full accuracy suite was not run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

This is a fused-MoE kernel microbenchmark, not an end-to-end serving benchmark. Default versus tuned results on the same container/model/Triton version:

| Tokens | Default (us) | Tuned (us) | Improvement |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 305.13 | 180.30 | 40.91% |
| 2 | 530.36 | 397.90 | 24.98% |
| 4 | 987.78 | 749.89 | 24.08% |
| 8 | 1732.48 | 1332.19 | 23.11% |
| 16 | 2927.57 | 2240.29 | 23.48% |
| 32 | 4591.12 | 3515.53 | 23.43% |
| 64 | 6176.29 | 4473.50 | 27.57% |
| 128 | 6998.44 | 4962.49 | 29.09% |

Geometric-mean fused-MoE kernel improvement: **27.32%** on the validation Radeon 8060S. No end-to-end TTFT/TPOT or serving-throughput claim is made.

Reproduction:

```bash
SGLANG_AWQ_MOE_TRITON_ROCM=1 \
python benchmark/kernels/fused_moe_triton/tuning_fused_moe_triton.py \
  --no-ray --model /models/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-AWQ-4bit \
  --tp-size 1 --dtype int4_w4a16 \
  --batch-sizes 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 --tune
```

## Limitations

- The down config reuses the tuned map and does not enable TMA yet.
- Configs are specific to Radeon 8060S/gfx1151, ROCm, and the active Triton version.
- End-to-end serving and full accuracy benchmarks are follow-ups, not claims of this PR.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [ ] Add unit tests.
- [x] Update documentation.
- [ ] Add full accuracy and end-to-end serving benchmarks.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, or `/rerun-failed-ci`.
4. After green CI and approvals, ask Merge Oncalls to merge.

@@ -153,6 +153,29 @@ After tuning, configuration files will be generated:
 
 Move these files to `sglang/srt/layers/moe/moe_runner/triton_utils/configs/triton_version/` directory to use them in SGLang.
 
+#### AMD Strix Halo / gfx1151 W4A16
+
+For `Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-AWQ-4bit` on Radeon 8060S, use the ROCm Triton path with the single-GPU local tuner:
+
+```bash
+SGLANG_AWQ_MOE_TRITON_ROCM=1 python benchmark/kernels/fused_moe_triton/tuning_fused_moe_triton.py \
+    --no-ray \
+    --model /models/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-AWQ-4bit \
+    --tp-size 1 \
+    --dtype int4_w4a16 \
+    --batch-sizes 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 \
+    --tune
+```
+
+The packed W4A16 config files are:
+
+```text
+E=256,N=256,device_name=Radeon_8060S_Graphics,dtype=int4_w4a16.json
+E=256,N=256,device_name=Radeon_8060S_Graphics,dtype=int4_w4a16_down.json
+```
+
+The gfx1151 profile was tuned over 72 ROCm configurations and eight batch sizes. The checked-in map improved fused-MoE kernel time by 23.1%–40.9% on the validation Radeon 8060S; retune when the GPU, ROCm, or Triton version changes. The down map currently reuses the tuned map without TMA.
+

 - **Mixtral**: mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1, mixtral-8x22b
